Definition: exiled; captured; as noun, exile (abstractly or concretely and collectively); by extension, booty
BiblicalUsage: Captivity here is the state, the capture, and the captives themselves. The Edomites come and carry away captives from Judah, the remnant of the captivity returns to build, and Jeremiah promises that God will save His seed from the land of their captivity. Numbers counts the captives taken in war alongside the prey.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God sees the captive as a person, not a number. He counts them, He promises to bring them back, and I hold that the return from captivity is a picture of every deliverance He still works.
